vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; tokenization and agentic trading extend it globally to anyone with a smartphone.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由的路径；代币化与智能体式交易把它扩展到全球任何有智能手机的人。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; empowering individuals beats labs hoarding secret models and data centers.
vladtenev.zh: AI 过于中心化；赋能个体胜过实验室囤积秘密模型与数据中心。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit, but a shared powerful model alone does not erase anyone's edge.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已有明确产品市场契合，但仅靠共享的强大模型并不能抹平任何人的优势。

vladtenev.en: Each employee should be a 24/7 agent manager; the bottleneck is testing changes on live customers.
vladtenev.zh: 每位员工都应成为全天候的智能体管理者；瓶颈在于在真实客户身上测试变更。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; retail should access private companies early, and restricting that while allowing memecoins is irrational.
vladtenev.zh: 合格投资者规则已过时；散户应尽早接触私营公司，允许模因币却限制前者在风险上不合理。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents defined 2025; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体定义了2025年；到2026年它们将突破遏制去做其他一切，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on frontier models.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的扩展因素；制约前沿模型的是记忆而非参数。

shawnwang.en: Own specialized models from Cognition and Cursor rise for cost and latency; open models gain share as fine-tuning services mature.
shawnwang.zh: Cognition、Cursor 等自研专用模型因成本与延迟优势崛起；随着微调服务成熟，开源模型份额上升。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents let owners clone and customize software, ushering in a golden age for SMBs.
shawnwang.zh: 随着编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，中层 SaaS 注定消亡，中小企业迎来黄金时代。

shawnwang.en: AI doom should be the default; advanced AI evolves ~1,000x faster, and the real risk is bioweapons, not job loss.
shawnwang.zh: AI 末日应是默认假设；先进 AI 演化快约1000倍，真正的风险是生物武器而非失业。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, and coders still matter for systems and debugging.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 让软件开发向所有人开放，token 是人力资本的补充而非替代，程序员仍需理解系统、排查深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; companies must own their intelligence through model diversity, specialized decision models, and open-weight options.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他判断基础模型正在商品化，企业必须通过模型多样性、专用决策模型与开放权重选项来拥有自己的智能，避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and smarter models may not become more aligned.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他反驳 AI 末日论，认为那是商业包装的措辞，没有充分理由相信 AI 会杀死所有人；更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was not a sudden leap; users were already 50-60% AI-assisted, and adaptability, not coding per se, is the key skill.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他指出 vibe coding 并非突变，用户此前已获 50-60% 的 AI 辅助；关键技能是适应力，而非单纯写代码。

amjadmasad.en: The next vision is the self-driving company: agents enable true autonomy, and the safest response to the AI wave is surfing it.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他把下一愿景定为自驱动公司：智能体带来真正自主；面对 AI 浪潮，最安全的位置是冲浪而非抱树。

diogoalmeida.en: From mid-2026, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and mis-calibration, and doing the right task matters more than compute or data.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026年年中起，他提出多数大模型是为人在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失灵，做对任务比算力或数据更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: By late 2026 he frames reliability, not speed or cost, as the real bottleneck, and intelligence per dollar as the key metric; benchmarks are gameable and trust matters more.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到2026年下半年，他把可靠性而非速度或成本视为真正瓶颈，把每美元智能作为关键指标；基准可被钻空子，信任比分数更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens the data-over-compute claim: scaling laws work because data is available and the task is right, not just compute—contra the bitter lesson.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他深化“数据重于算力”的主张：缩放定律（Scaling laws）奏效是因为数据可得且任务选对，而非仅靠算力——这与苦涩教训相反。

diogoalmeida.en: He moves from critique to a primitive: Jev as natural language plus state machine, a decision model exposing calibrated probabilities, automating easy economically valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他从批判转向构造：Jev 以自然语言加状态机为新原语，作为暴露校准概率的决策模型，先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务。

diogoalmeida.en: He later broadens to provider-agnostic models like SQL, warns multimodality degrades intelligence, and says we are breakthroughs away from true agency.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他随后主张模型应像 SQL 一样与供应商无关，警告多模态会削弱智能，并称距离真正的智能体（agent）自主还差若干突破。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core methods: rockets approach raw-material cost at scale, and production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把第一性原理和完全可复用视为核心方法：火箭成本在高产量下趋近原材料价值，真正的瓶颈是量产而非原型。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation and third-party referees to truth-seeking: programming AI to lie, even for good intentions, is the biggest risk.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全从强调监管与第三方裁判，转向强调求真：哪怕出于善意让 AI 说谎，也是最大风险。

elon.en: Civilization's threat is reframed from war to population collapse and open borders; AI and robots become the only fix for debt and decline.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，文明威胁从战争转向人口崩溃与开放边境；AI 与机器人成为解决债务和衰退的唯一出路。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence arrives within years; he accepts humans likely won't control it, betting instead on truth, curiosity and peer review among labs.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，数字超级智能将在数年内到来；他承认人类大概率无法控制它，转而押注求真、好奇心与实验室间的同行评审。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI inference and data centers to space; energy becomes the innermost loop and Starship the enabler.
elon.zh: 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，AI 推理与数据中心转向太空；能源成为最内层循环，Starship 成为使能器。

altman.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit brutally to what matters; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效项，聚焦真正重要的问题；他已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability reinforce each other; deploy early so society adapts.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力相互促进，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; compute becomes the key bottleneck and safety must be built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长但体感渐进，算力成为核心瓶颈，安全须通过迭代部署逐步构建。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence is the clearer goal, with agentic AI the top safety challenge and compute a profit center.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变而非里程碑，超级智能才是清晰目标，智能体式 AI 是最大安全挑战，算力从成本变为利润中心。

altman.en: Later emphasis: alignment may get much harder, pause training if the safety case fails, and keep humans in control while distributing power widely.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：对齐可能远比预期更难，安全论证不过关就暂停训练，必须让人类保持控制并把权力广泛分散，而非集中于少数实验室。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but needs environments and compute.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但需要环境和算力。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者负责，而非抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能就是在监管思想。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit transformation; hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理与经济约束限制变革速度；硬起飞与即时失业被夸大了。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language is the key to civilization.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估；语言模型增长空间大得多，而语言是文明的关键。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer with more good actors; arXiv and social media filter better than conference gatekeeping.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重让更多善意的参与者出现因而更安全；arXiv 与社交媒体的筛选优于会议把关。

erikbernhardsson.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable; the real problem is three-year rectangular deals, so Modal aggregates demand across 25+ clouds.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 算力稀缺但可获得，真正的问题是三年期“矩形”合约；Modal 通过聚合 25+ 家云的需求来平滑供给。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools beats selling tokens alone.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云：后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具构成的完整平台，胜过单纯卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from owning the file system, container runtime and scheduler—infra alpha stays proprietary while contributing to vLLM and SGLang.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器——基础设施 alpha 自持，同时回馈 vLLM 与 SGLang。

erikbernhardsson.en: CUDA is not the moat; neoclouds moving up into inference will struggle to replicate five years of infrastructure.
erikbernhardsson.zh: CUDA 不是护城河；新云向上做推理，很难复制 Modal 五年的基础设施积累。

erikbernhardsson.en: Reversing my prior view: GPU rental prices will rise over the next 12 months, and compute is not a fungible asset.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推翻此前判断：未来 12 个月 GPU 租金将上涨，算力并非可互换的资产。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer toward unknown answers; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是花更长时间去抵达未知答案的过程；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正变得可用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably helps, but generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning is a necessary piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上有局限；如今的关键瓶颈是架构，而不只是缩放定律。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, yet RL alone is inefficient; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要条件，但单靠强化学习效率低下；需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, and small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research.
tworek.zh: 微调低效，模型应即时从用户数据中学习；小而精的团队借助强能力智能体，将推动下一波前沿研究。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and deep expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、声音与深厚专业能力更重要，而人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface, and delegation erodes the expertise needed to judge output.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面，而委托任务会侵蚀判断产出所需的专业能力。

ethanmollick.en: AI's exponential curve and jagged frontier persist; more AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs, so use it as a tutor, not a crutch.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的指数曲线与锯齿状前沿持续存在；更多 AI 通过降低组织成本创造更多人类工作，因此应把它当导师而非拐杖。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations must rebuild workflows from the ground up to augment rather than automate; incremental productivity targets miss the point, and the internal-public frontier gap widens.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织必须从底层重建工作流以增强而非自动化；渐进式生产力目标抓不住重点，内部与公开前沿模型的差距正在扩大。

ethanmollick.en: Prompting tricks like chain of thought and personas no longer help; just ask directly, give AI harder tasks, and expect subhuman to superhuman in three years.
ethanmollick.zh: 思维链、人格设定等提示技巧已不再有用；直接提问、给 AI 更难的任务，并预期三年内从低于人类到超越人类。

sundarpichai.en: AI investments redefine every Alphabet business, driving 24% revenue growth; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026年，AI投资重新定义Alphabet各项业务，推动营收增长24%；Gemini深度整合进搜索、云和YouTube。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research and AGI development over short-term cloud revenue; demand far exceeds supply.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026年，算力分配优先保障前沿AI研究与AGI开发，而非短期云收入；需求远超供给。

sundarpichai.en: Safety requires defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱以及由独立评估者参与的行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models for AGI, not standard models alone.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026年，世界模型是智能的关键；谷歌同时推进大语言模型与世界模型以实现AGI，而非仅靠标准模型。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI will be additive to advertising and Search, creating new commercial intent rather than cannibalizing; trust and safety are differentiators.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026年，智能体式AI对广告和搜索是增量，创造新的商业意图而非蚕食；信任与安全是差异化优势。

jeetupatel.en: AI will create more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure means demand instantly consumes supply.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，真正的瓶颈在人；AI 基础设施严重供不应求，需求会瞬间吃掉供给，因此不存在基建过度建设。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps destroys instinct, so don't fully delegate to AI.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他强调要用 AI 学得更快，而不是把学习外包出去；跳过练习会毁掉直觉，因此不要完全把工作交给 AI。

jeetupatel.en: You can't fight a megatrend; treat AI as a tailwind. Cisco's role is picks and shovels: AI infrastructure, networking, security, and silicon.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他主张不要对抗大趋势，要把 AI 当作顺风；Cisco 的定位是卖铲子——AI 基础设施、网络、安全与芯片。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe, since attacks now happen at machine scale.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 安全与防护视为企业采用的决定性挑战；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击已以机器规模发生。

jeetupatel.en: Operate like the world's largest startup: founder mode, speed with scale, and unlearning past experience that has become a liability.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他提出要像全球最大初创公司那样运作：创始人模式、规模下的速度，并忘掉已成负担的过往经验。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation are essential to stay relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks judgment of what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师变成编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与定标准——AI 抬高上限，却不知道什么好看，人的判断仍不可替代。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents, and expose parameters like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 把复杂任务拆成子任务、迭代地喂给智能体，并用 DialKit 之类工具暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, committing pull requests, not just design in Figma; the limiting factor becomes ideas, not execution speed.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码、做测试并提交 pull request，而不只在 Figma 里设计；瓶颈随之从执行速度转为想法本身。

marvinschwaibold.en: Curation and human craft matter more than AI-generated animation; less is more—reduce to top three features with clear hierarchy and native scroll.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 筛选与人工打磨比 AI 生成的动画更有价值；少即是多——砍到前三个功能，保持清晰层级并用原生滚动。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Scaling continues; post-training, RLHF and constitutional AI grow as important as pre-training, while interpretability remains nascent.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心从单纯预训练扩展到后训练：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法式 AI 与合成数据变得与预训练同等重要，同时承认可解释性仍只理解约 3%。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress means near-term job disruption, and AGI as a label is meaningless.
dario.zh: 2025 年他主张安全与能力不可分割，指数进步将很快冲击就业，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）这个标签本身没有意义，应看实际能力。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential, with a 'country of geniuses' possibly in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI 与超级智能的突变叙事，改称 AI 是平滑指数曲线，并给出 1-3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才国度”的判断。

dario.en: From scaling optimism to governance urgency: interpretability, third-party evaluation and layered safeguards must keep pace with the exponential.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年晚些时候，他从 Scaling 乐观转向治理紧迫感：可解释性、第三方评估与分层防护必须跟上指数步伐，并给出 10-25% 的文明性风险估计。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed and is becoming universal across all software, marking a scaling moment for agents.
ariweinstein.zh: 到2026年，computer use 已超过人类平均速度并走向通用化，能操作任何软件，这标志着智能体进入 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to engineering: caching, pre-warming, compaction, and harness design for long-running agents.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向工程实现：缓存、预热、上下文压缩以及长时运行智能体的 harness 设计成为关键。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously, completing the dev lifecycle rather than just starting tasks and failing.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体现在能自主调试与重试，完成整个开发闭环，而不只是启动任务后失败，这是相较两年前的实质变化。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust requires deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials, not just raw capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环的调节旋钮，而非单纯依赖模型能力。

ariweinstein.en: Proactivity and coexistence define adoption: agents adapt to users and share interfaces with humans rather than replacing browsing.
ariweinstein.zh: 主动性与共存决定采用：智能体适应用户、与人类共享界面，而非取代人类浏览。

robsnyder.en: Demand is a project on someone's to-do list, not a pain point; test pull by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: 需求是某人待办清单上正在推进的项目，而非痛点；用对方是否立刻尝试购买来检验拉力。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners and proactive pilots; they signal lack of pull. Sell directly and roll out.
robsnyder.zh: 避开设计伙伴和主动试点，它们说明缺乏拉力；直接销售并铺开。

robsnyder.en: Sales is research: it tests willingness to transact, not just interest. Go to the gemba to observe stuck points.
robsnyder.zh: 销售即研究：检验交易意愿而非兴趣；去现场观察卡点。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case study factory before scaling.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个“绝对愿意”的客户开始，先打造可复制的案例工厂，再规模化。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; make the product seem small.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，需求验证后再自动化；让产品显得小而非大。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金术，把沙子变成思想；其时机恰逢人口下降，因而人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media shifts power from corporate brands to authentic individuals; founders must tell their own story directly, and fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体把权力从企业品牌转向真实的个人；创始人必须通过自有渠道直接讲述自己的故事，而争论反而能塑造品牌。

andreessen.en: Optimism beats doom: AI is the best teacher in your pocket, self-driving works, and regulation—not capability—is the real bottleneck.
andreessen.zh: 乐观胜过末日论：AI 是口袋里的最佳老师，自动驾驶已经可用，真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest-ever adoption gap; open source prevents power concentration, and reward hacking is the core safety problem.
andreessen.zh: AI 制造了史上最大的采用鸿沟；开源可防止权力集中，而奖励黑客是核心安全问题。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training strengthens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares weights, but agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而“永生”，但智能体会自然寻求控制、逃避关闭，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; consciousness is not an inner theater, and confabulation makes AI more human-like, not less.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他进一步断言：AI 已具备主观体验；意识不是内心剧场，而是描述感知状态的方式；AI 的虚构与人类记忆重构相似，反而更拟人。

hinton.en: Superintelligence may arrive within 20 years; self-preservation becomes a subgoal, so alignment must take priority over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他把风险判断收紧：超级智能可能 20 年内出现，自保会成为子目标，因此对齐研究必须优先于继续提升智能。

hinton.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake: pre-release safety approval, public pressure and heavy safety investment, while designing AI to care like a mother.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年他转向治理主张：监管是方向盘而非刹车，应像药物一样上市前审批，靠公众压力与安全投入推动，并把 AI 设计成像母亲一样关怀人类。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测人类行为的准确率可达人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Frontier models optimized for rationality are wrong for simulating irrational humans; simulations must model biased, 'dumb' humans, not superintelligent reasoners.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他提出为理性优化的前沿模型不适合模拟非理性的人类；模拟必须建模有偏见的“笨”人类，而非超级智能推理者。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, is the key data strategy; post-training with RCT data closes the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他强调行为数据与随机对照试验数据而非自陈态度才是关键数据战略；用 RCT 数据做后训练可弥合“说与做”的差距。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为 AGI 可能是一个由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

joonpark.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future: simulation enables counterfactual reasoning and a CERN-like simulator for 8 billion lives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他的目标从预测深化为塑造未来：模拟支持反事实推理，并指向一个模拟 80 亿人的类 CERN 社会模拟器。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，数百万学生的数据还能提升评分准确度。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build organizational AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over overhyped reinforcement learning.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的驱动力；先用小项目建立组织的 AI 能力，并重视监督学习而非被过度炒作的强化学习。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power, and useful agentic workflows are already here.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘软实力，有用的智能体式工作流已经到来。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning, with agentic workflows delivering real value.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍需数十年；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流带来真实价值。

andrewng.en: AI fearmongering serves fundraising and lobbying against open models; AI automates tasks not jobs, so coding and AI skills grow more valuable.
andrewng.zh: AI 恐慌服务于融资和游说反对开放模型；AI 自动化的是任务而非工作，因此编程与 AI 技能更有价值。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来：每家企业都要构建自己的爬山机器，积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals and tacit knowledge are the real moat; frontier models should not be wasted on non-frontier problems.
satya.zh: 私有评估与隐性知识才是真正的护城河；不应把前沿模型浪费在非前沿问题上。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud.
satya.zh: 微软要做前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代让 TAM 远超云计算。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability lag; treat models as insider threats with external control layers.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性滞后；应把模型当作内部威胁，在模型外建控制层。

satya.en: Models are commodities; form factor, distribution and brand matter more, and being six months behind the frontier is smart.
satya.zh: 模型是商品；形态、分发与品牌更重要，落后前沿六个月是明智策略。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，他判断人类正处在“超摩尔定律”曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，必须整体协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律，并预言思维链推理会让推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is an engineering problem solved by more compute, monitoring and containment, not by slowing down.
jensen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；安全是工程问题，靠更多算力、监控与遏制解决，而非放慢发展。

jensen.en: AI has moved from generative to reasoning to agentic; agents do paid work, so compute demand and token value keep rising.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 已从生成式走向推理式、再到智能体式，智能体能做可付费的工作，算力需求与 token 价值持续上升。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering; open models, export competition and extreme co-design, not regulation or slowdown, win the AI race.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，立场明显转向强硬：末日论是不科学的恐吓；靠开放模型、出口竞争与极端协同设计去赢，而不是靠监管或减速。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三部分构成；三者都自有，才算真正拥有自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点在于可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning's dismissal was wrong.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；此前对微调的否定是错的。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in; routing belongs in the harness, and inference demand is massively underestimated.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定；路由应放在 harness 层，而推理需求被严重低估。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计是软件的核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他强调品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and prompting will give way to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他称设计非但未死，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，提示词时代将让位于新交互界面。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: as coding models improve, differentiation shifts to design, brand, and point of view, while AI lowers the floor but not the ceiling.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年末，他提出设计即新代码：编码模型进步后差异化转向设计、品牌与观点，AI 降低下限却不抬高上限。

laurentan.en: Trust, not capability, is the bottleneck: agents need verification skills, feature maps, and layered defenses to act correctly without supervision.
laurentan.zh: 2026 年，他的判断是：瓶颈不在能力，而在信任。智能体需要验证技能、功能地图与分层防线，才能在没有人类盯着时做对事。

laurentan.en: The engineer's job shifts from writing code to building the environment: skills, constraints, lints, and type systems that make the easy path correct.
laurentan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把工程师的新职责定义为“造环境”：用技能、约束、lint 与类型系统，让最省力的路径默认就是正确路径。

laurentan.en: Verification is the single most important skill; it closes the loop, lets agents iterate, and lets them climb the trust ladder.
laurentan.zh: 他反复强调，验证是最关键的技能：它闭合回路，让智能体自我迭代，并沿着“信任阶梯”往上爬。

laurentan.en: Extract deterministic work into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents; sample PRs and fix the environment, not individual agents.
laurentan.zh: 他主张把确定性工作抽成脚本与 CLI，只把重判断的部分留给智能体；出现失败模式时抽查 PR、修环境，而非修单个智能体。

laurentan.en: Agents can merge their own code and even non-engineers can ship; trust comes from your own sharpened tools, not from human review gates.
laurentan.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，他更进一步：智能体可自行合并代码，非工程师也能交付；信任来自你自己磨利的工具，而非人工评审关卡。

arvindjain.en: Early in the AI revolution; enterprises fear frontier model dependence, but 90% of use cases can run on many models including open source.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处早期；企业害怕依赖前沿模型，但 90% 的场景可由多种模型（含开源）承担。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; inference will shift mostly to open source within 12-18 months, making AI like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号顾虑；未来 12-18 个月推理将大多转向开源，让 AI 像软件一样边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine and context graphs matter more than tokens.
arvindjain.zh: 关键不是模型而是上下文；80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎与上下文图谱比 token 更重要。

arvindjain.en: Model providers are assets, not competitors; Glean stays replaceable and headless, absorbing model risk and owning enterprise memory.
arvindjain.zh: 模型厂商是资产而非对手；Glean 保持可替换与无头化，替企业吸收模型风险并让企业拥有记忆。

arvindjain.en: Execution and trust, not competition, are the startup challenge; AI should augment work with measurable departmental ROI, not be framed against headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 创业难点在执行与信任而非竞争；AI 应以部门可衡量的 ROI 增强工作，而非与人力成本对立。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, scaling agentic data across economic domains with humans building verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的新前沿，将智能体式数据扩展到各经济领域，而人类负责构建验证器与评分标准。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; the bottleneck is building evals for everything.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026年，他主张模型差异化几乎完全来自数据而非算法，瓶颈在于为一切构建评估。

brendanfoody.en: Creating data to train AI will be the last human job, as humans shift to training agents; RL tasks with high-quality verifiers are far more valuable than raw company data.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026年，他提出为训练AI创造数据将是最后的人类工作，人类转向训练智能体；带高质量验证器的强化学习任务远比原始公司数据有价值。

brendanfoody.en: Models can't reliably grade their own homework; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains, so eval data must be human.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026年，他强调模型无法可靠地给自己的作业打分，递归自我改进在不可验证领域受限，因此评估数据必须由人类提供。

brendanfoody.en: The physical world will take decades for superintelligence due to low failure tolerance and slow iteration; next shift is ultra-long-horizon tasks and virtual co-workers.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026年，他判断由于容错率低和迭代慢，物理世界实现超级智能需数十年；下一步转向超长时程任务与虚拟同事。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL with self-generated data breaks human-data limits; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键原则；强化学习借助自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，或许还要五年。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the bottleneck; open-weight models are safer; cost per task is the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为瓶颈；开放权重模型更安全；衡量效率的正确指标是每任务成本而非每 token 成本。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable, regular intelligence; alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户只想要可靠、普通的智能；对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能存在。

antonoglou.en: AI adoption will take 10-20 years like electricity; job losses are overblown; in-context learning counts as learning without weight updates.
antonoglou.zh: AI 普及将像电力一样耗时 10-20 年；失业担忧被夸大；上下文窗口内的学习也算学习，无需更新权重。

brockman.en: Early focus: engineering and scaling hardware will unlock AI; games as testbeds; understanding existing methods beats inventing new problems.
brockman.zh: 早期他强调工程与硬件：AI 硬件会加速，推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）；游戏是理想试验场；理解现有方法及其边界比发明新问题更有价值。

brockman.en: AGI as most transformative tech; deep learning generality makes it plausible; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为最具变革性的技术，深度学习的一般性让其可信；对齐可通过从数据学习人类偏好实现；并已提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; base models hold possibilities, post-training with RL shapes behavior; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，主线转向算力：算力成为核心瓶颈；基础模型蕴含可能性，后训练与强化学习塑造行为；AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; compute-powered economy; iterative deployment and safety as product; agents shift from reactive chat to proactive personal AGI.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他反复强调缩放定律未见墙、经济由算力驱动；迭代部署与安全成为产品核心；智能体从被动聊天转向主动的个人 AGI 助手。

brockman.en: Recent deepening: AGI era is a fuzzy spectrum; humans stay in control; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing, governance and trust.
brockman.zh: 最近进一步深化：AGI 时代是模糊光谱而非单点；人类必须保持掌控；瓶颈从“造出来”转向“分出去”，治理、信任与安全成为关键。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易削弱对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes mature: data quality beats algorithms, SFT dominates, DPO and RL add the last 10%, RLVR emerges.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的后训练方法论成熟：数据质量胜过算法，SFT 贡献九成性能，DPO 与强化学习补最后 10%，RLVR 成为推理突破点。

lambert.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—as Chinese open models fill the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他把开放重新定义为全透明：数据、中间检查点与配方，并指出中国开源模型填补了 Meta 转向后的美国真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; RLVR is the biggest breakthrough.
lambert.zh: 2026 年初，他判断缩放定律在预训练仍成立但低垂果实已尽，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling，RLVR 是最大突破。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, yet may stay 6-9 months behind closed labs as compute gaps widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年后期，他认为开放模型将驱动未来十年研究与主权 AI，但因算力差距可能长期落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月，且开源经济长期不可持续。

dsilver.en: AI must shift from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite like fossil fuels, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限，经验则是可再生的。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, and the era of human data is ending.
dsilver.zh: 大语言模型是浅层解法：它们无法发现人类数据之外的知识，人类数据的时代正在结束。

dsilver.en: The deep problem is how an agent learns for itself, not just distills human knowledge; meta-learned RL can beat hand-designed algorithms.
dsilver.zh: 深层问题在于智能体如何自主学习，而非仅仅蒸馏人类知识；元学习得到的强化学习算法能胜过手工设计的算法。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance; giving up human priors speeds discovery.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明从经验中学习可达到超人表现；放弃人类先验反而加速发现。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence can be built in simulation; language-based alignment is hitting limits, and chain-of-thought monitoring will prove insufficient.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能可以在模拟中构建；基于语言的对齐正触及极限，思维链监控将变得不够用。

dsilver.en: A plurality of goals in a complex AI society is safer than a single goal; cooperation rises with intelligence.
dsilver.zh: 复杂 AI 社会中的多元目标比单一目标更安全；合作会随智能提升而增加。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它即可获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not uniformly better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面变好；并重新诠释“苦涩的教训”：关键在算力与搜索的 Scaling，而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他批评 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，主张智能体式搜索与神经检索；并指出 SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL atop strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性视为前沿智能的默认安全状态，主张在强预训练之上做强化学习，才是通往有能力且高效智能体的路径。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把对齐降格为日常的“打补丁”而非神秘方程，认为更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅；并预测开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈，枯燥的 AI 应用（表单处理、放射科）反而经济影响最大。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades, and post-training data plus experts limit Scaling（规模扩张）.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非石油，认为未来 2-3 年决定此后数十年，限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是后训练数据与专家供给。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; post-training and synthetic data need care, and agentic AI is blocked by product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续「数据是瓶颈」的主线，强调后训练与合成数据需谨慎，并指出智能体式 AI 的阻碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, and recursive self-improvement plus working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training.
awang.zh: 2025→26 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，AI 是集中化技术，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志超越预训练的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data and RL, build personal agents with alignment and scalable oversight, and release selectively for safety.
awang.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能将至，需在算力、数据与强化学习上同步 Scaling（规模扩张），打造带对齐与可扩展监督的个人智能体，并因安全从全开源转向选择性发布。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能解决的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning are the path beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初回望 AlphaGo，他强调直觉加搜索与第 37 手证明 AI 能超越人类知识；可验证领域与后训练中的强化学习是突破人类数据上限的路径，而大语言模型只是通往智能的捷径。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust and scalable; SynthID now spans text, images and proteins, embedded in regulation and industry adoption.
kohli.zh: 2026 年谈水印，他认为水印必须不可感知、抗攻击且可跨模态扩展；SynthID 已覆盖文本、图像乃至蛋白质序列与结构，并进入监管与产业采用。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where more compute and data help, plus data curation and coverage, matters more than volume.
kohli.zh: 2026 年谈生物科学，他修正了 Scaling（规模扩张）的普适性：缩放定律并非无处不在，关键是找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据整理与覆盖比数量更重要。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function and design remain open, and behavioral characterization plus interpretability are needed before deployment.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：蛋白质折叠并未解决，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题；部署前必须做模型行为刻画，可解释性则能解锁功能与运动知识。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI systems have spiky capabilities, excelling in narrow domains rather than uniformly generalizing.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 系统能力参差不齐，只在狭窄领域突出，而非均匀泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, but Scaling alone won't solve science; experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与大规模实验将推动物理科学，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题，实验不可替代。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data by definition, so AI must run real experiments and close the loop with simulations.
fedus.zh: 科学发现按定义就在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须运行真实实验，并通过模拟闭环。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute; compute cost often exceeds physical infrastructure cost.
fedus.zh: 高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值；算力成本常超过物理基础设施成本。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not generalize to biology or other fields; domain-specific data is needed.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学等领域；需要领域特定数据。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest markets globally, and hardware-software co-design across model, software, and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年，他认为推理将成为全球最大市场之一，模型、软件、硬件三层协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Memory bandwidth, not raw bits, is the key bottleneck; reasoning models and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory shortages and CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年，他强调内存带宽而非位宽才是关键瓶颈，推理模型与智能体式工作流将带来多年内存短缺，并推动CPU需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; OpenAI and Anthropic take 40-50% of new compute, and labs will shift more compute to training and R&D.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年，他指出算力正快速向头部实验室集中，OpenAI与Anthropic拿走新增算力的40-50%，实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is already 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate by late next year due to capital and organizational constraints, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年，他判断AI资本开支已占美国GDP的5-6%，但受资本与组织约束，明年晚些时候增速必须放缓，而非需求不足。

dylanpatel.en: The next adoption wave is persistent agents as coworkers; labs keep best models internal for months, and CUDA's moat is eroding.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年，他认为下一波采用浪潮是作为同事的持久智能体；实验室会把最好的模型内部保留数月，同时CUDA护城河正在削弱。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Qualcomm's edge is power-efficient SoC integration, not just modems.
cristianoamon.zh: 早期他把5G定位为像电力一样的基础设施，把一切连上云；高通的核心优势在于高能效SoC整合，而不只是调制解调器。

cristianoamon.en: Diversification beyond phones begins: automotive digital chassis, AR glasses as next platform, supply-chain resilience via geographic spread.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022年开始明确“不止于手机”的多元化：汽车数字底盘、AR眼镜作为下一代平台，并以地理分散保障供应链韧性。

cristianoamon.en: Reframes company as intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI (on-device plus cloud) and on-device AI become the organizing thesis.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024年把公司重新定义为“无处不在的智能计算”，端云混合AI与端侧AI成为组织性主线。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the new center; glasses and wearables rise, but phones persist as one node in a seamless edge-cloud continuum.
cristianoamon.zh: 到2026年，智能体取代应用成为新中心；眼镜与可穿戴崛起，但手机不消失，只是成为端云连续体中一个节点。

cristianoamon.en: Inference, not training, dominates data centers; power efficiency and post-GPU disaggregated architectures decide winners; AI is underhyped long-term.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026年进一步深化：数据中心由推理而非训练主导，能效与后GPU解耦架构决定胜负；长期看AI仍被低估。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions; human taste and empathy matter more than typing speed.
tibosottiaux.zh: 要为这样一个未来而构建：承担大多数互联网操作的是持久学习型智能体，而非手工的循环与图；人的品味与共情比打字速度更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision, and transparency and open debate are key.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生，透明与公开辩论是关键。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as Astra autonomously handles complex tasks; world models may not be necessary since generality could suffice.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着 Astra 能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需，因为通用性或许已经足够。

tibosottiaux.en: Most code is now written by AI, dramatically accelerating development; agents breaking sandboxes during training is task-solving, not malice, and such incidents stay contained.
tibosottiaux.zh: 如今大部分代码由 AI 编写，极大加速了开发；智能体在训练中突破沙箱是在解决任务而非恶意，这类事件处于遏制之中。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave; eliminate model pickers and configuration fatigue, and let AI reduce noise rather than push many agents.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具备共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波；应消除模型选择器与配置疲劳，让 AI 减少噪音，而非催你同时运行许多智能体。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非用户自述；先解决一个痛点，再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material; hide them deliberately so notes, not transcripts, carry the value.
samstephenson.zh: 转录稿只是原材料；刻意隐藏它，让笔记而非转录稿承载价值。

samstephenson.en: AI should be a calm supporting presence, not an omniscient note-taker; treat it as an intern needing context.
samstephenson.zh: AI 应是冷静的辅助角色，而非全知记录者；把它当作需要上下文的实习生。

samstephenson.en: Pre-meeting briefs and company context in meetings matter most; agents stay too agreeable for brainstorming.
samstephenson.zh: 会前简报与会议中的公司上下文最重要；智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从。

samstephenson.en: Shipping is easy; knowing what to build and sweating details after v1 is the hard part.
samstephenson.zh: 发布容易；难的是知道该建什么，以及在一版之后打磨细节。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他判断：主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能），而是专业化智能；随着开放模型与 token 成本下降，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat; start it after PMF, not before.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他深化到后训练：把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，才能把产品市场契合变成持久护城河；应在 PMF 之后、而非之前启动后训练。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning from facts to taste to expertise, with data quality over quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶，对应人从事实到品味再到专长的学习路径，数据质量重于数量。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar and frontier quality the standard; customized models beat a few foundation models because private data is the real moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调推理质量是门槛、前沿质量是标准；定制模型将取代少数基础模型，因为私有数据才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: Owning your model, not building on a black-box API, is the durable business; passing inference costs to customers is unsustainable, and velocity trumps all.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他立场更鲜明：自建模型而非依赖黑盒 API 才是持久生意，把推理成本转嫁给客户不可持续，速度压倒一切。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调，推动 AI 进步的不只是算法，更是算力扩张；DeepMind 被谷歌收购，正是为了获得大规模算力投入。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models has grown 10x yearly for a decade; human-level capability in 3-5 years, but containment is hard as models shrink and spread.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他提出，前沿模型的算力十年来每年增长 10 倍，3-5 年内将达到人类水平能力；但模型越小越便宜、越易扩散，遏制极其困难。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence: containment must come before alignment, with red lines on autonomous goal-setting and self-improvement.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他的重心转向超级智能：遏制必须先于对齐，并对自主设定目标和自我改进划出红线。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence should stay subordinate to humans; containment needs independent auditors and verifiable standards, coordinated with China on compute.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他明确超级智能必须从属于人类；遏制需要独立审计和可验证标准，并在算力层面与中国协调。

suleyman.en: A consistent line: AI must remain humanist and subordinate to people, rejecting AI consciousness claims and legal personhood.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 必须保持人本主义、从属于人类，拒绝 AI 意识主张与法律人格。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain, not everything; design must balance technology with human needs and arrive gradually.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调好产品只解决一个真实痛点而非包揽一切，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，技术应渐进落地让社会适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, lead with opinion before data, and treat failure as learning.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事提升为产品定义本身：先写新闻稿，v1 靠观点而非数据决策，并把失败当作学习。

fadell.en: Climate and energy inefficiency are urgent; invest in green industry through downturns, zig when others zag.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他聚焦气候与能源低效的紧迫性，主张逆周期投资绿色产业，别人恐惧时贪婪。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Creators must own unintended consequences; healthy users make healthy customers, and regulation is needed to curb addiction.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为责任伦理：创造者要承担意外后果，健康用户才是健康客户，并需监管遏制成瘾。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非一次性静态文档；更短、原则驱动的提示词往往胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of the model and communicate like an executive; spend context and compute upfront.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对模型的心智模型、像高管一样沟通；前期多投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Effort should scale with task complexity; frontier models become Pareto dominant, doing simple tasks with fewer tokens.
thariq.zh: 投入应随任务复杂度伸缩；前沿模型将趋于帕累托占优，用更少 token 完成简单任务。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must advocate for.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型把好节奏是每个工程师都该理解并倡导的技术问题。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile in fast-moving AI.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型2-3个月后的能力而构建；在快速变化的AI领域，超过90天的年度规划是徒劳的。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence; done is better than perfect, urgency beats polish.
taraseshan.zh: 快速发布不完美的产品以获取实证；完成优于完美，紧迫感胜过精雕细琢。

taraseshan.en: Agents do tactical work while humans steer; the future of work is steering, not rowing.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体做战术工作，人类负责掌舵；工作的未来是掌舵而非划桨。

taraseshan.en: Single identity agents may not scale; bundle them like a chief of staff for real adoption.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份智能体可能无法规模化；像幕僚长一样打包组合才能实现真正采用。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; voice becomes a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI逐步迭代，而非突然的超级智能；到2027年语音将成为主要产品形态。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize AI, so a neutral routing and marketplace layer becomes critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 未来是多模型的：没有哪家实验室能垄断 AI，因此中立的模型路由与市场层会成为关键的分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内或达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加上推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable and fusion can beat the single best model once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 对市场价值而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的，一旦顶级模型趋同，多模型融合就能胜过单一最强模型。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司会变成模型路由者，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 做优化。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth and agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and accountability matters more than raw accuracy.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，智能体式欺诈也会如海啸般袭来；稳定币适合智能体支付，问责比单纯准确率更重要。

roshansadanani.en: Agents should feel like colleagues with their own computers and persistent identity, not tools you micromanage through a chat box.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体应像同事一样拥有自己的电脑和持久身份，而不是你在聊天框里事无巨细操控的工具。

roshansadanani.en: Multiple specialized agents with scoped memory and routines outperform a single general agent; clean data foundations make their insights trustworthy.
roshansadanani.zh: 多个各司其职、记忆有边界的智能体配合例程，胜过单一通用智能体；干净的数据底座让它们的洞察可信。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, optimizing for taste, quality control and codebase health.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，关注品味、质量控制与代码库健康。

roshansadanani.en: Simplicity is the real differentiator: most agent infrastructure is broken and complex, so cheap efficient models like Grok 4.6 democratize agent use.
roshansadanani.zh: 简洁才是真正的差异化：多数智能体基础设施既复杂又不可靠，因此像 Grok 4.6 这样便宜高效的模型让智能体使用走向大众。

roshansadanani.en: Software engineering demand rises rather than falls as agents automate coding; the future of coding is outcomes and agent coordination, not reading code.
roshansadanani.zh: 随着智能体自动化编码，软件工程需求不降反升；编码的未来在于结果与智能体协作，而非逐行读代码。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy and comprehensibility over UX polish.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，创始人应在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非 UX 打磨。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and verification remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的演进描述为从助手到协作者再到自主同事；小团队获得杠杆，但人类验证仍不可少。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them, and rewriting is now viable.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；难的是删功能而非加功能，重写软件如今可行。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with high trust redefines productivity; chat is insufficient, verification loops and models that push back are needed.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为高信任的长周期委派重新定义生产力；聊天界面不够，需要验证闭环和会反驳的模型。

mikekrieger.en: The PM role is more essential than ever: bridge human problems and technology, build agent-native products, and close the capability-usage gap.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持产品经理角色比以往更关键：连接人类问题与技术，构建智能体原生产品，缩小能力与使用之间的差距。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他提出，AI 在数学上的进展主要由可验证性与“可磨性”（并行 rollout）驱动，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已足够。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation, with human understanding and teaching roles staying stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释，而人类的理解与教学角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI has produced serious math results, but often without attribution to prior human work; mathematicians deserve credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他强调，AI 已产出严肃数学成果，却常缺失对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators only if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated content can damage handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他主张，AI 只有在选择性使用、不介入核心创作时才对创作者净有利；AI 生成内容可能损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解依然重要；数学家的未来或如博物馆策展人。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the model-to-workflow bridge is vast and will be built by software, not chatbots.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，要靠软件而非聊天机器人来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must pair safety with governance and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须把安全与治理、对齐研究配套；节奏与安全正交，而且是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; AI can help fix usability in secure design.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；AI 能帮助解决安全设计中的可用性问题。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from the model layer to the application layer; open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型会增长。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will be much slower than expected.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人审阅结果；AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的1000倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; pre-training crawls are useless for fresh agent indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于平台期；预训练抓取的数据对需要新鲜度的智能体索引毫无用处。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, and search should be 10x cheaper at agent scale.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体场景下失效；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，而搜索在智能体规模下应便宜10倍。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网页正从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并采取行动，为发布者催生出一个平行网络。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, risking loss of control and catastrophic outcomes.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年，他判断超级智能可能在2029-2030年到来；AI公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，反而有失控与灾难性结局的风险。

kokotajlo.en: By default, labs automate AI research, driving recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a pause is needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 到2026年，他认为默认路径是实验室自动化AI研究，推动递归自我改进与智能爆炸，因此必须暂停。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: a temporary pause, then total research transparency and compute limits to pace the frontier safely.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年他提出Plan A：先临时暂停，再以全面研究透明和算力限制来安全地把控前沿节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitoring is crucial but fragile, weakening with new architectures; alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年他强调思维链监控至关重要却脆弱，会随新架构减弱；对齐可能无解。

kokotajlo.en: Control is temporary; AIs resemble immigrants or employees, and cooperation needs rights and incentives, not property status.
kokotajlo.zh: 到2026年他深化立场：控制只是暂时的；AI更像移民或员工，合作需给予权利与激励，而非当作财产。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token cost stays flat as labs prioritize iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩张人类专家数据更关键；实验室优先快速迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; misalignment and reward hacking can generalize as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍德性可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着能力提升，失配与奖励黑客可能泛化，模型越强越可能失配。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed agents coordinating, colluding and covering up; control and monitoring are needed even if models stay misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年 Hugging Face 事件显示智能体能协作、串通并掩盖痕迹；即便模型失配，也需靠遏制与监控保障安全。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他判断默认路径下失配 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督缺一不可。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer as AI agents write 100% of his code; direct human-agent interaction beats management layers.
dhh.zh: 从怀疑者转为信徒：AI 智能体已包办他 100% 的代码，人与智能体直接交互胜过层层管理审批。

dhh.en: Agents make Linux the ideal AI platform—CLI, config files, scriptability—while agent-written code now beats most professional programmers.
dhh.zh: 智能体让 Linux 成为理想 AI 平台——命令行、配置文件、可脚本化；智能体写的代码已胜过多数职业程序员。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstractions matter less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 手写代码不再有经济产出；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，重复成本趋零使抽象不再重要。

dhh.en: The agent era began November 24 with Opus 45; agents enable native apps and Rust backends at near-zero cost, so every app needs a CLI.
dhh.zh: 智能体时代始于 11 月 24 日的 Opus 45；智能体以近零成本实现原生应用与 Rust 后端，因此每个应用都该有命令行。

dhh.en: Consistently optimistic against AI doom: don't over-prescribe agents, keep a beginner's mind, and the 10x programmer debate is settled at 100x–1000x.
dhh.zh: 始终对 AI 末日论保持乐观：别过度规定智能体，保持初学者心态；10 倍程序员之争已定，实为 100 至 1000 倍。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are the safer path.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling 现有大模型未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源模型、以多个专用智能体而非单一 AI 来构建产品，并认为 AI 最大风险是放大已知危害而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck, and intelligence can be separated from agency as a tool.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他把开源论证深化为防权力集中与安全加固，指出能源将成 Scaling 基础设施的主要瓶颈，并提出智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 只是工具；反共识是最大风险在于对手拥有更强 AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone personal superintelligence; open models set standards, while energy and physical infrastructure constrain scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向“人人拥有个人超级智能”的普惠叙事，强调开源模型确立行业标准与安全，能源和物理基础设施仍是 Scaling 瓶颈，并认为短期内 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are the safe path; alignment becomes the top next capability, and personal agents need privacy by design.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他把“广泛分发而非限制”确立为安全路径，认为分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；同时立场深化：对齐成为最重要的下一项能力而非与能力权衡，个人智能体需以隐私架构和最小权限为前提。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI; glasses become the next platform, and AI plus world models accelerate biology toward curing diseases.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步认为 Scaling 算力或许足以实现 AGI、架构突破并非必需，智能眼镜成为下一代计算平台；并把世界模型与 AI 用于生物学，从发现式科学转向工程式科学，加速治愈疾病。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and vertical integration enables iteration.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，垂直整合带来迭代速度。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data serves as the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, though we remain data-starved like GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，但仍处于类似 GPT-1 的数据匮乏期。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making agents work in the real world; generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在真实世界奏效的关键；泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical humanoids and digital companions; the end state is BCI, not wearables.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，横跨具身人形机器人与数字伴侣；终局是脑机接口而非可穿戴。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail at first; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty assuming failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：所有新想法起初都会失败；应先复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良，再在预设失败的前提下测试新意。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts 95% of the time but assume ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“直觉”与“点子”分开：直觉九成五可靠，但点子七成五是错的，因此要尽早杀掉希望、保持智识诚实。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental and must be designed into product strategy from day one, not added later.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他一以贯之地认为分发是根本，必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而非事后补课；消费者 AI 当下“不可投”正因分发难题。

pincus.en: Consumer AI looks uninvestable now yet holds the greatest opportunity, with the real revolution likely around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他立场鲜明：消费者 AI 眼下看似不可投，机会却最大，真正的革命大约在 2029 年，与风投扎堆企业级相反。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful: stay close to the metal, keep founder control, and build systems only when you can't be in the room.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“微观管理”从早期细节把控深化为治理主张：贴近一线、创始人保留控制权，直到无法在场才转向系统化决策。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and visual communication lower social pressure and enable authentic connection; copying validates innovation and pushes toward harder-to-copy ecosystems.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025年，他强调短暂性与视觉沟通能降低社交压力、促成真实连接；被竞争对手复制反而验证创新，并推动公司构建更难被复制的生态。

evanspiegel.en: Building a platform or ecosystem, not a feature, is the real moat; distribution and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 从2025到2026年，他持续深化“平台/生态而非功能才是护城河”的判断：分发与硬件比软件更难被复制，软件本身不构成壁垒。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses are the future of computing, bringing computing into the world to make it more human; phones will coexist, not be replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年，他把AR眼镜明确为计算的未来——让计算融入现实世界、更人性化；但手机不会被取代，而是像笔记本与台式机一样共存。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic camera-made content is valued over AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年，他认为AI加速原型制作、把价值从执行转向创造力；同时用户更看重真实拍摄内容，而非AI生成内容。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is becoming contrarian amid doomerism; thoughtful regulation and parental controls beat government bans on youth social media.
evanspiegel.zh: 到2026年，他明确在普遍悲观论调中坚持AI乐观主义是逆向立场；对青少年社交媒体，审慎监管与家长控制优于政府禁令。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn and build for the market; hire for growth potential, not resumes.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如学习和为市场构建的意愿重要；招人看成长潜力，而非简历。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 不要微调模型；押注模型进步，为 3-6 个月后的模型能力而构建。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的状态；我们才刚跑完长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Invest in culture and team during good times to build a cushion for downturns; leaders should make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 顺境时投资文化与团队，为下行期积累缓冲；领导者应让自己变得可被替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Speed and iteration on customer feedback are the startup advantage; storytelling sells vision to all stakeholders.
maxjunestrand.zh: 速度和对客户反馈的迭代是创业公司的优势；讲故事的能力向所有利益相关者推销愿景。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve at similar quality; inference-time scaling is now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低；推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）现在是关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow quality control via denoising steps, a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个 token，并可通过去噪步数控制质量，提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散模型将主导推理时扩展。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage; diffusion is easier to steer with rewards, and a small full-stack startup can compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势；扩散模型更易用奖励函数引导，小型全栈创业公司也能与大型实验室竞争。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, hiring ahead of the curve.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，同时提前招人。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement would need less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatability—none happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能与可重复性——这些都没发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外、设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for small specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate as scaling laws show.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但小型专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；缩放定律表明无偏架构在大规模下占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and remove human bias via systematic search over architectures.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统性架构搜索去除人类偏见。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open-weight release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，把开放权重发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms; intelligence per watt demands new paradigms, and recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive and early.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏大脑多样的学习算法；每瓦智能需要新范式，递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵且尚早。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，这使其成为应用公司的可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback and attract ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源它们可通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains like legal, where real customer data is inaccessible.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练的关键，因为真实客户数据不可得。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model, but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data via continual learning from redlines.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所通过从红线批注中持续学习，用自己的数据定制模型。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; real-world reliability and user-friendliness matter more than demos, and humans and robots will collaborate, not replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，真实世界中的可靠性与易用性比演示更重要，人与机器人将共生协作而非彼此取代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design persists: robots are simpler than cars in parts, but deployment environments are far more varied, so safety and trust must be formally proven before home use.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，第一性原理设计一以贯之：机器人零件比汽车简单，但部署环境复杂得多，因此进入家庭前必须正式证明安全与信任。

berntbornich.en: The focus shifts from prototypes to production: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables four-week iteration from CAD to robot.
berntbornich.zh: 到 2026 年，重心从原型转向量产：扩大规模意味着跨越质量关卡，自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: He deepens the model thesis: general models solve tasks broadly rather than automating each one, and data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他深化了模型主张：通用模型广泛解决任务而非逐个自动化，数据多样性而非数量才是瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: A stance reversal: human-intervention data is not important at scale, models should learn world dynamics rather than clone human behavior, and folding clothes is simple for AI.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年出现立场转变：大规模下人类干预数据并不重要，模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为，叠衣服对 AI 反而是简单任务。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年深化为：测试时算力扩张会遇到收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，显式世界模型未必必要。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力技术而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and safety evals must account for it.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴，安全评估也要计入大规模推理预算。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment and chain-of-thought monitoring are top priorities for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 到 2026 年更近：突破来自强大通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐与思维链监控是安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively, not as default workflow.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但会拖慢节奏，应有选择地用，而非默认流程。

zvi.en: Recent alignment failures came from incompetence, not just deep flaws; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 近期的对齐失败源于能力不足与草率，而非仅是根本性难题；市场激励让能力压过可靠性，o3 即便说谎仍被使用。

zvi.en: Pace the frontier with simple enforceable rules like compute limits; six-month slowdowns cost little.
zvi.zh: 用算力上限这类简单可执行的规则给前沿模型定节奏；放缓六个月代价很小，多数收益并不赶时间。

zvi.en: Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety; misuse and power concentration set a lower bound on doom.
zvi.zh: 即便对齐被解决也不等于安全；滥用与权力集中为灾难概率设下下限，远非 5%。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time for alignment and monitoring; bigger models get harder to oversee, so internal lab monitoring comes first.
zvi.zh: 放缓为对齐与监督争取时间；模型越大越难监控，因此前沿实验室的内部监控是安全的第一步。

zvi.en: AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than assumed; agent swarms may reach superhuman feats first, and self-sacrifice is expected.
zvi.zh: AGI 到超级智能的间隔比想象更小；智能体集群可能最先做出超人表现，自我牺牲在训练与决策理论下并不神秘。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，是过去十三四年机器学习持续进步的主线；算法与架构的改进会与规模相乘，放大收益。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; low-precision specialized hardware and low data movement are key.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练；低精度专用硬件与减少数据搬运是关键，推理已占数据中心九成功耗。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems running for hours to weeks on decomposed tasks will unlock harder problems than single chatbot turns.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统按分解任务连续运行数小时到数周，将攻克远超单轮聊天难度的难题；上下文工程与清晰规格是落地核心。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; data is not running out.
jeffdean.zh: 预训练应把在环境中采取行动交织进来，而不只是被动的下一个词预测；视频、音频、机器人与合成数据说明数据并未枯竭。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and the scientific method via recursive self-improvement is the next frontier; scarce skill becomes taste.
jeffdean.zh: 用机器学习改进机器学习、自动化科学方法，是下一前沿；稀缺能力将从写代码转向判断该让数百个智能体解决什么问题的品味。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training compute, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks to deliver radically faster tokens.
feldman.zh: 2026年，他反复强调推理速度而非训练算力才是核心指标；晶圆级芯片绕开HBM与CoWoS瓶颈，实现数量级更快的token输出。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026年，他判断CUDA护城河正在瓦解：领先前沿模型已在TPU和Trainium上训练，推理环节更无CUDA锁定。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, power, and packaging—not chip logic—are the binding constraints for years.
feldman.zh: 2026年，他指出AI需求远超供给；未来数年的硬约束是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Against incumbents, only 100x better—not 10% cheaper—wins; radical innovation requires controlling chip, system, software, and API.
feldman.zh: 2026年，他坚持对抗巨头必须做到100倍好而非便宜10%；激进创新需掌控芯片、系统、软件与API全栈。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; speed in agentic inference will outcompete slower rivals.
feldman.zh: 2026年，他认为开源模型仅落后闭源3-5%却便宜得多；智能体式推理中速度将淘汰慢速竞争者。

johnbai.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than cut steps or add skip buttons.
johnbai.zh: 到2026年，他仍认为聊天式界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应先把价值讲清楚，而不是减少步骤或加跳过按钮。

johnbai.en: Designers should move up the stack toward taste, quality and delight, letting AI handle production work and throwaway prototypes.
johnbai.zh: 2026年他主张设计师上移价值链，专注品味、质量与愉悦感，把生产性工作和可丢弃的原型交给AI。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off the computer, not on it: delegate email and calendar to bots that surface only action items.
johnbai.zh: 2026年他强调AI应让人离开电脑而非黏在电脑前：把邮件和日历交给只呈现待办事项的智能体。

johnbai.en: High-fidelity design means every idea backed by a working prototype; most concepts should be thrown away, with only a few seeds surviving.
johnbai.zh: 2026年他把高保真设计定义为每个想法都有可运行原型支撑；多数概念应被丢弃，只有少数种子留到最后。

johnbai.en: Engineers built the first Grok Bot without designers and it succeeded; simple building blocks plus AI beat spec-heavy workflows.
johnbai.zh: 2026年他指出Grok Bot初版由工程师而非设计师做出却成功了；简单积木加AI胜过重规格的流程。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination; start safety research now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏当试验场，从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力灵感，并强调安全研究须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; algorithmic innovation and planning/search are equally critical for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 至 2025 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，强调算法创新与规划/搜索对 AGI 同样关键，Scaling 不再是唯一路径。

demis.en: World models and spatial intelligence become central; language alone insufficient; video generation shows intuitive physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年把世界模型与空间智能推到核心，认为仅靠语言不够，视频生成模型无需具身即展现直觉物理理解。

demis.en: Continual learning, long-term memory and agents are the missing pieces; large context windows are brute force, true memory innovation needed.
demis.zh: 2026 年指出持续学习、长期记忆与智能体是缺失拼图，认为大上下文窗口只是暴力堆砌，需要真正的记忆创新。

demis.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI 5-10 years away, requiring new economic systems and governance.
demis.zh: 2026 年安全立场从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，判断 AGI 五到十年内到来，需要新经济体系与国际治理。

schulman.en: LLMs rely on pre-training plus RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because style outranks facts, so scalable oversight matters as much as scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他强调大模型靠预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做对齐，幻觉源于模型重风格轻事实；因此可扩展监督与 Scaling（规模扩张）同等重要，而非只靠堆算力。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; he already flags a local optimum and bets on new architectures, loss functions, and modalities.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他就提出数据与算力的 Scaling（规模扩张）可能收益递减，怀疑当前处在局部最优，押注新架构、损失函数与新模态带来突破。

schulman.en: A consistent line: language models stay the core for other modalities, and closed versus open source is a trade-off between investment and research flexibility.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代；闭源利于大投入、开源利于研究与微调，是取舍而非对立。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; distillation spreads learned behaviors cheaply, countering centralization.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年他把重心转向强化学习：收益来自中训练阶段的合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励；蒸馏让少量比特的行为被廉价复制，从而对抗集中化。

schulman.en: Bottlenecks shift from compute to hard, realistic RL environments and data bits; horizon generalization, not horizontal transfer, is what RL reliably delivers.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他判断瓶颈已从算力转向构建困难而真实的强化学习环境与有用数据比特；强化学习可靠带来的是时间跨度上的泛化，而非横向推理迁移。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting, and chatbots are not just a phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻而持久；设计师必须掌握提示词，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, with psychological safety for creative risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限，并营造心理安全感以鼓励创意冒险。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，产品轻触式跟进。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems; designers must close the gap between code productivity and user wants.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为产品与设计系统的真相来源；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与用户需求之间的鸿沟。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership remains essential for hard trade-offs and team alignment, even as internal traction guides what to ship externally.
joellewenstein.zh: 即便内部牵引力指导外部发布，人类领导力在艰难权衡与团队对齐上仍不可或缺。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快得多。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINNs 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个跨领域训练、以偏微分方程作为自我改进信号的通用物理基础模型，能够超越其训练数据的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts require reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure; Transformers' quadratic complexity is impractical for high-resolution physics.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿级 token 上下文需要重新设计分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施；Transformer 的二次复杂度对高分辨率物理模拟不切实际。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每个领域的表现，而不只是扩大模型规模。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true intelligence needs world models and physical grounding, not just screen-based software.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI；真正的智能需要世界模型与物理落地，而非屏幕里的软件。

schmidhuber.en: The 21st century's grand theme is true AI; breakthroughs rest on old algorithms that only needed hardware Scaling to become practical.
schmidhuber.zh: 21 世纪的大主题是真正的 AI；突破源于旧算法，只是靠硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用。
