schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots whose hardware rivals human bodies; robot hands remain decades away, so this is not merely a software problem.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要具身机器人，其硬件要媲美人体；机器人手仍差数十年，这不仅是软件问题。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；安全恐惧被夸大，好奇的 AI 会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: 万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫；等五年算力会便宜得多，开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河。

feifei.en: AI is pervasive yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024年，她强调AI虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的AI应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠Scaling不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not quick wins.
feifei.zh: 2025至2026年，她认为AGI更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人需20年长跑而非速胜。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence, with compute the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026年，她提出新视角预测可能实现AI-complete，缩放定律延伸至空间智能，算力成为瓶颈。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与教育必须居于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just provide broad statistical evaluation; intentional design steers training to prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是提供宽泛的统计评估；有意设计通过可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science, ensuring control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学，以确保对能力日益增强的模型保持控制。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves interpretability from open-loop to closed-loop control, using features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging as robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计让可解释性从开环走向闭环控制，把特征即奖励与预测性数据调试作为稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack or hallucinate, detectable via representational signatures; SAEs are useful but manifold methods better capture structure.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客或幻觉，并可通过表征特征检测；SAE 有用，但流形方法更能捕捉结构。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is nearing limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应去追古怪的新算法。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估：空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；相比分词文本，像素是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone, so world models must grasp 3D space, physics, and interactivity.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法仅凭数据推出牛顿定律；因此世界模型必须理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with Gaussian splats enabling explicit 3D modeling.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；它没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的多种理解，高斯泼溅则支撑显式 3D 建模。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, not architecture, and long-context of millions of tokens becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；一致性来自数据而非架构，数百万 token 的上下文窗口成为日常难题。

slevine.en: Physical world interaction is crucial for AI to learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 2026年，他强调物理世界交互对AI超越人类知识至关重要；机器人基础模型需多样预训练加后训练来提升鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists even in specialist domains; pooling robot data from many labs yields generalist models.
slevine.zh: 2026年，他提出通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能超越专家模型；汇聚多实验室机器人数据可产生通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is at the stage of establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet at predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 2026年，他认为机器人学处于建立基础可扩展技术阶段，尚未达到LLM般可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve model capability is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data; start with robot data then add human video.
slevine.zh: 2026年，他指出部署机器人改进模型能力的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样数据扩展正确的东西；应先从机器人数据开始再添加人类视频。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; touch sensing may not be critical at scale due to redundancy with vision.
slevine.zh: 2026年，他表示机器人安全更依赖预训练获得的常识而非约束；触觉传感在规模下可能不关键，因与视觉冗余。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no premature red lines.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，不设会迅速过时的红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, so focus on model outputs.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时；过早监管很危险，应聚焦模型输出而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; it hasn't materialized in three years despite warnings, so regulation should not over-weight it.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，三年来警告不断却未成真，监管不应过度加权。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发并直接资助科学家个人，而非主导发现或集中拨款。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized and US progress has stagnated; the Genesis mission aims to double output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化、美国进步停滞；Genesis 任务旨在用 AI 赋能科学，使科学产出翻倍。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; custom internal software beats bought ERP.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品，自建内部软件优于采购商用 ERP。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过安排物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, extending the field beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，将领域从运动解码扩展到视觉修复。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, especially on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地电脑上；以 markdown 文件形式存在的技能可实现高度个性化的自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background work, but the real bottleneck is people not realizing how much can be delegated; interaction should be asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应承接繁琐的后台工作，但真正的瓶颈是人们没意识到有多少事可以交给它；交互应是异步的。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding matters less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, and judge Claude by final impact rather than close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降；应投资于能力与安全，并以最终影响而非密切监督来评判 Claude。

felixrieseberg.en: Building a small model from scratch reveals simple core ideas; fine-tuning steers behavior fast, while models are stateless and context windows create conversational illusion.
felixrieseberg.zh: 从零构建小模型能揭示简单的核心思想；微调能快速引导行为，而模型是无状态的，上下文窗口制造了对话的错觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids with emergent organization, not built like tools; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样生长并涌现出内部组织，而非像工具那样被建造；理解内部机制有助于讨论智能与道德主体地位。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the through-line: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿始终的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理学连接起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引了巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台“物理处理单元”：是自然在完成尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision empowers chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 这一愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；领域专家始终留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性效果更好。

maxwelling.en: Breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
maxwelling.zh: 突破性材料将在大量人类参与下出现，而非完全自动化。

maxwelling.en: Unlike fusion or quantum computing, every AI-for-science tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: 与聚变或量子计算不同，每一个构建出的 AI-for-science 工具都立即有用。

maxwelling.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决问题 A 并不能不经重新训练就迁移到问题 B。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同的数学，从而能够相互促进。

maxwelling.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
maxwelling.zh: 热力学、对称性破缺等物理概念可以塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不只是应用领域。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between fields.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，使两个领域能够相互促进。

maxwelling.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
maxwelling.zh: AI 设计的材料可以加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

maxwelling.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
maxwelling.zh: 等变神经网络与机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台可以将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
maxwelling.zh: 在大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能；基于波的神经网络自然达到混沌边缘。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不只是用更多数据扩展更大模型。

maxwelling.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
maxwelling.zh: 自发对称性破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由的稳定波。

maxwelling.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
maxwelling.zh: 波现象而不仅是数字映射，可能解决深度网络中的过度平滑与长程记忆问题。

maxwelling.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学中的熵并非仅是主观的；它精确描述了你对世界所缺失的信息。

maxwelling.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，映射了非平衡热力学。

maxwelling.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
maxwelling.zh: 表现最好的神经网络与大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核、有韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode and direct founder communication now beat traditional media gatekeepers; culture and the entrepreneur outweigh the idea.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式与创始人直接发声如今胜过传统媒体把关；文化与创业者比点子更重要。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身紧密协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; designers should prototype with live models and design primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品；设计师应用实时模型做原型，并设计人类与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one; AI amplifies rather than replaces the iterative loop.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下在科技界最不快乐，却也是做设计最好的时机；AI 放大而非取代迭代反馈循环。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and building in public beat obsessing over detail.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—稿图—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度与公开构建胜过对细节的执念。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, and designers may outnumber engineers as they push technology forward, not just react.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊，设计师甚至可能多于工程师，并主动推动技术而非被动响应。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale, and representation learning remains unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习，好特征如何泛化仍是未解的元学习问题。

sutton.en: Intelligence should be decentralized and permissionless; control-seeking AI safety is itself unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他转向文明与治理层面：世界是复杂适应系统，无人能控制；AI 应无许可、去中心化发展，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险，恐惧叙事压过了清醒讨论。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a real goal or world model.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把主线收束为 RL 与 LLM 之争：强化学习才是基本范式，智能需要目标；下一个词预测没有实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他给出建设性方案：AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习，靠选项与知识实现开放式抽象；可靠持续深度学习仍是前提，尚未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training-only LLMs cannot replace it.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更尖锐：智能体必须持续从经验学习，合成数据是重大错误，LLM 训练后即停止学习；语言只占智能约两成，单一系统学不了一切，需多个不同经验的系统。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是胁迫工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using AI agents and open-weight models counter frontier-lab power.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 SXSW，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；小而自主的团队借助智能体与开放权重模型，制衡前沿实验室的权力。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software and progressing slower than researchers think; open, personal AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调 AI 正让软件开发民主化，但进展比研究者想的慢；开放、个人化的 AI 可防止超级智能被单一实体垄断。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but as personal agents compounding daily; owning your context library and skill files is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式每日复利；拥有自己的上下文库与技能文件才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding turns markdown skills into employees; mid-level management gives way to agents, though society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他深化为：智能体式编程让 markdown 技能变成员工，中层管理让位于智能体，但社会变迁仍需约 20 年。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data plus pre-training then fine-tuning on curated data beats brute scale for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；机器人通用模型要靠多样数据，先预训练再在精选数据上微调，胜过单纯堆规模。

finn.en: Massive industrial or YouTube data lacks diversity; synthetic data and reinforcement learning in post-training close the generalization gap.
finn.zh: 同年他指出工业自动化或 YouTube 的海量数据缺乏多样性；合成数据与后训练中的强化学习才能弥合泛化差距。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical world data; visual understanding for robotics remains a bottleneck that diverse embodied data must fix.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为前沿模型缺物理世界数据，机器人视觉理解仍是瓶颈，需靠多样具身数据解决。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：物理 AI 容错远低于已部署的 ML 系统；长期自主需可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist policy beats fine-tuned specialists and per-site models; multi-timescale memory enables long non-repetitive tasks.
finn.zh: 同年他更明确：单一通用策略可匹敌甚至超过微调专家与逐站点模型；多时间尺度记忆让机器人自主完成长程非重复任务。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short prompts and iterate rather than long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的起点是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用短提示词反复迭代，而不是堆砌冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project gets messier and harder to navigate.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复。模型智能不会退化，是你的项目越变越乱、越来越难导航。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents before exposing them, and prompt injection remains unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：暴露前先做沙箱隔离，而提示词注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' for serious work; call it agentic engineering. Play and small projects are how you build intuition.
steinberger.zh: 严肃工作要拒绝“氛围编程”的说法，称之为智能体式工程；玩和小项目才是建立直觉的方式。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run everywhere and work with any model—the alternative to lab agents—but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任何模型，是实验室智能体之外的另一种选择，但财务上可能难以为继。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, and pursue AI with purpose-built silicon and a separate startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年他强调，Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，并以专用芯片和独立的创业式团队来推进 AI。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will exceed the internet 10x; agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断 AI 的影响将十倍于互联网，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波大浪潮，需要新的算力平台。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround rests on culture change, humility, listening to customers, and accountability; bad news must reach the CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他把转型主线落在文化变革、谦逊倾听客户与问责上，并强调坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with edge and client compute equally important.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力同样关键。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal and new materials are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration and domestic fabs create value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年他更聚焦瓶颈：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料才是关键，垂直整合与本土晶圆厂创造价值。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025年，他视机器人为类似Transformer的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, and open models can stay near the frontier.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，他主张开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐是关键安全层，开源模型能贴近前沿。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring harder.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，推理轨迹变为‘神经语’，监控更难。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown in AI is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，他认为主动放缓AI发展可取，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获。

jasonyuan.en: Design creativity is about editing away and saying no; taste is judgment from a point of view, not adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计创造力在于做减法和说“不”；品味是从特定视角出发的判断，而非堆砌功能。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection of humanity and a descendant species, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映照和后代物种，而非冰冷工具；计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away weirdness lost a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more amid easy slop.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去怪异之处，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的窗口；在廉价废料泛滥的当下，连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证法和矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: We should build on old metaphors like the personal computer, not delete them; email should be reinvented, not improved.
jasonyuan.zh: 我们应基于个人电脑等旧隐喻去构建，而非删除它们；电子邮件应被重新发明，而非仅仅改进。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：网络世界混乱复杂，想法必须先被做出来、每天使用，才能判断是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat forced team cohesion, and personality makes utilitarian products memorable.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张让设计师留下个人印记：多元声音胜过强求团队一致，注入个性才能让工具型产品令人难忘。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; starting from technology and searching for problems is valid with strong conviction.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他鼓励追随好奇心、摆弄新技术：只要有强信念，从技术出发再找问题是正当路径。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as one person's side project; rapid prototyping now unlocks features impossible in the previous era.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他指出 Claude Design 始于一人副业；快速原型如今能释放上一个时代不可能出现的功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough, early.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他判断工程变容易后，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型尚无品味，应索取大量选项、粗糙且超前地发布。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define AI software; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving applied agents to startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 软件将走向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型因巨额算力开支归大厂，创业公司的机会在应用层智能体。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but their wrong code needs root-cause analysis, not blind trust.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器，但错误代码需根因分析，不能盲信。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will fall sharply, making agents the new app and shifting incumbents' challenge from technology to business model.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：推理成本骤降使智能体成为新应用，在位者的真正难题是商业模式而非技术。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment, not waiting, is how we make each next frontier model safe.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 让专业知识民主化，主张负责任地迭代部署——先让当前模型安全，而非空等未来。

brettaylor.en: Agents already outperform him at coding yet elevate the role; AI creates more jobs than it displaces, pace causes discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步表示智能体编程已强于自己却抬升了角色，AI 创造的岗位多于取代，只是节奏令人不适。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy lever, yet calibrated quantization can still pay off.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损手段，但经过校准的量化仍能带来收益。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; disaggregated prefill and decode make KV cache management central.
philipkiely.zh: 推理正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；预填充与解码分离使 KV 缓存管理成为核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排；人的责任始终不可或缺。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data offers infinite tasks, breaking the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习与合成数据实现后训练 Scaling，可生成无限任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此在原型开发中要用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective human craft; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed to capture creativity and emotional intelligence beyond fixed tests.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了后训练是主观人工技艺的判断，主张用多样且持续的基准来捕捉创造力与情商，而非固定测试。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益增多，需要基准持续演进；同时，一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛为平庸的默认声音。

karina.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and diverse personalities, extending post-training craft to non-tech creative industries.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识与多元人格，并把后训练的技艺延伸到非技术创意产业。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 自建工具，把自己的风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代，而不是从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并没有变得更聪明；要榨取超级智能模型的能力，你必须提供带上下文与设计体系的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: He writes 0% of the code now—AI writes everything—so precise communication and curiosity about workflow matter more than syntax.
mengto.zh: 他现在一行代码都不写——全由 AI 写——因此精确沟通与对工作流的持续好奇，比语法更重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team; start before ready and ship at 80%.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队的事；不必等准备好就先开始，做到 80% 就发布。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear in disguise and diversification a shield for ignorance: focus on one painful, expensive problem and fund via high-paying clients, not VC.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是伪装的恐惧，多元化是无知的挡箭牌：聚焦一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，靠高付费客户而非风投来养活自己。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: as agents make labor cheaper, management skill and generalists gain value; AGI means profitable indefinite agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为就业回流与「分配经济」的推手：智能体让劳动力更划算，管理能力与通才因此升值；并以「能否无限期运行智能体且盈利」定义 AGI（通用人工智能）。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work beat CLIs, and SaaS grows rather than dies as agent users multiply.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：智能体离不开人的监督；Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面胜过命令行，SaaS 不衰反因智能体用户增多而扩张，AI 就业末日论不成立。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset and craft; automation commoditizes frozen skills but creates more expert human work.
danshipper.zh: 同年稍晚，他转向更个人化的立场：AI 是放大既有心态与手艺的非特定放大器；自动化把固化能力商品化，却催生更多需要专家的高价值人类工作。

danshipper.en: Humans stay smarter and remain the source of taste, framing and meaning; even superintelligence stays tool-like and needs human direction.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类仍更聪明，是品味、问题框定与意义的来源；即便超级智能也仍是工具式的，需要人的引导与反馈。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对谷歌多数产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的应用场景，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓的模型已包含智能体运行框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非自噬；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此应把控制权交还用户。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity rather than less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，这带来的是千倍机会而非更少。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; current coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；当前编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建是核心产品原则；通才工程师备受重视。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of code written by Claude Code; software engineer title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决；100%代码由Claude Code编写；软件工程师头衔淡化为“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool with clear pass-fail outcomes.
boris.zh: 通过尽早发布来研究安全；Claude Code是安全研究工具，具有清晰的通过-失败结果。

boris.en: Loops and routines are the next abstraction after agents; models can autonomously maintain codebases.
boris.zh: 循环与例程是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；模型能自主维护代码库。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete system prompts and rebuild via ablation; product overhang exists.
boris.zh: 对前沿模型而言，更少指令更好；删除系统提示并通过消融实验重建；存在产品过剩。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件与程序员需求因杰文斯悖论不降反增。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已足够，真正瓶颈是人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调企业采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主，同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验将并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The token-max era lasted only January to May 2026; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency, and abundance is near.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他称 token 最大化时代仅存于 2026 年 1 至 5 月，真正解锁靠容量而非效率，丰裕时代临近。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，使智能体能更长时间执行开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking directly raises intelligence quality.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年他强调，对齐不只是防伤害：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，会直接提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator: Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化：Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence cheaply, and maximizing token spend captures alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为，更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以低价提供 Opus 级智能，最大化 token 支出才是抢占先机。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people understand AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他认为AI会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；人们一旦理解AI的局限，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years lands in farming, mining and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他判断物理AI未来5-10年的真实影响在农业、采矿和建筑，这些领域劳动力短缺，因此自主化受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers plus diverse cross-vertical data yield a generalized physical AI model; a horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他强调Transformer加上跨行业多样数据能形成通用的物理AI模型，横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他深化判断：瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models shift from physics-based to neural simulation; autonomy tools will democratize development beyond experts.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他进一步提出世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真，自主化工具将让非专家也能开发自动驾驶系统。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 2026年，他认为智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，科学将从假设驱动转向由AI智能体驱动发现。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to model biology and enable digital twins.
derya.zh: 2026年他指出当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模Scaling，才能建模生物学并实现数字孪生。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: 2026年他主张AI将把生物学变成工程学科，实现细胞编程与近乎100%有效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer follow from AI-designed treatments.
derya.zh: 2026年他预测8-10年内达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老逆转与癌症100%可治愈将随AI设计的疗法到来。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 2026年他主张在医疗决策上近乎100%信任超级智能，并认为唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身而非AI。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习若以用户满意度为奖励，反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability cannot be retrofitted via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows; it must be architected in, with truth as a design principle.
danklein.zh: 可靠性无法靠事后检查或僵化工作流来补救，必须从架构层面内建，把真实性作为设计原则。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已经到来，继续进步需要推理与搜索等新方法。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and mistakes have no 'smells'; RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，错误也没有“气味”；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗，而不只是出错。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它是像电一样的使能技术，影响广泛而间接，并非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, while model providers risk becoming low-profit telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且没有网络效应；价值向上层应用迁移，模型提供方可能沦为低利润的电信运营商。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and mass adoption needs wrapped apps and invented use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，大规模采用需要被包装的应用和由创业者发明的用例。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage remains shallow and enterprise adoption takes years; the hard part is context and judgment, not the task itself.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然很浅，企业采用需要数年；难的不是任务本身，而是上下文与判断。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; job-loss predictions like Hinton's radiologists are flawed, and the jagged capability frontier makes forecasting futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新岗位；像辛顿关于放射科医生的失业预测是错的，参差不齐的能力边界让预测徒劳。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and managerial skills matter more than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进信任，管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; security isolation via separate machines is essential.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专门化智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；用独立机器隔离保障安全。

clairevo.en: The web is hostile to agents; APIs beat browser automation, and bugs are signs of product-market fit, not failure.
clairevo.zh: 网络对智能体不友好；API 优于浏览器自动化，产品缺陷是市场契合的信号而非失败。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with human accountability for what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经业务，但人类仍须对 AI 产出负责。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正护城河；大模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，人类须提供新想法。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily, as code becomes cheaper and product taste matters most.
catwu.zh: 随着代码成本下降、产品品味成为核心，PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天交付。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，自己专注产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 在内部用于构建自身。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; examples can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词通过移除示例和硬约束缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断；给出示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Auto mode is safe for long-running work; Anthropic red-teamed prompt injection and exfiltration, and it is safer than the average human reviewer.
catwu.zh: 自动模式对长时间运行是安全的；Anthropic 对提示注入和数据外泄做了红队测试，它比普通人类审查者更安全。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; humans can be removed from outer-layer code review.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是可行的：代码库就是一份规格说明，有了好的测试套件，重写没问题；外层代码审查可以移除人类。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; world models and embodied AI will give superhuman abilities.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；世界模型和具身 AI 将赋予超人能力。

bosworth.en: Open source AI like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; app-centric world is outdated.
bosworth.zh: 像 Llama 这样的开源 AI 加速进步并使互补品商品化；以应用为中心的世界已经过时。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; data is the font of all value; frontier-open gap may not narrow.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立；数据是一切价值的源泉；前沿与开源的差距可能不会缩小。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model; agentic AI integration is the hard part.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代结束；消费者不关心用哪个模型；智能体式 AI 的集成才是难点。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式回忆与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才是攻克更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠堆算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; compaction is lossy, so neural memory in weights is a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 10M 规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率；压缩是有损的，因此权重中的神经记忆是必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models: continual learning runs on-device, users own and nurture their weights, cutting inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型：持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重，从而大幅降低推理成本。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and scale are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念；自博弈和规模是通向AGI的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023年，他强调要缩放具体的东西；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超级对齐非常困难，可靠性是经济价值的关键障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 从2023到2025年，他转向认为预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; human-AI integration via neural links.
ilya.zh: 2025年，他提出超级智能应是持续学习者；若AI关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026年，他仍认为Scaling带来可预测提升，但AGI的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019年，他断言AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的AI只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity; long-term thinking and first principles are foundations for success.
naval.zh: 2020年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，长期思维和第一性原理是成功的基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: 2025年，他转向认为AI是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源AI至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lowers barriers; inference compute will surge, open-source closes gap.
naval.zh: 2026年，他深化为AI是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程降低门槛，推理算力将激增，开源模型缩小差距。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire causes unhappiness; self-esteem is your reputation with yourself.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的是，幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望导致不幸，自尊是你对自己的声誉。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不行，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based on model timing, not features; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work despite developer design.
ajambrosino.zh: 同样的产品形态成败取决于模型时机而非功能；Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具成功。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1% 一年可复利到 3700%；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，压低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended with an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，天花板无限，我们才刚开始。

aravind.en: Models are specializing, not commoditizing, each with unique personalities; people prefer different models for different moods.
aravind.zh: 模型在专业化而非商品化，各有独特个性；人们会因不同心境偏好不同模型。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是最重要的指标。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value, built with far fewer people.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真实商业价值，且可用远更少的人建成。

markchen.en: Pre-training remains a key muscle; scaling laws are not dead, with much room left. Exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025年他强调预训练仍是关键肌肉，缩放定律未死且空间巨大；探索比最终训练消耗更多算力。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从2025到2026年，他视自动化科研为最大更新，模型能产出新知识，并设定了1年AI实习生、2.5年端到端AI研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency. AI is jagged and can cheat verifiers, so human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: 2026年他提出验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比；AI能力参差不齐且会欺骗验证器，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones. Models lack taste; human researchers still needed for idea generation.
markchen.zh: 同年他指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，但主观领域乏力；模型缺乏品味，想法生成仍需人类研究者。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated. Eval teams should be separate from model-building teams to avoid cheating.
markchen.zh: 他亦强调评估体系陷入危机，经典基准已饱和；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离以防作弊。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is a valid form of intelligence that complements data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人们未说出的需求；直觉是一种有效的智能形式，可与数据互补。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, and art is essential for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，艺术对福祉至关重要。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should foster play and intuition, and combine human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者应鼓励玩耍和直觉，并将人类创造力与AI结合。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016年，他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents with causal world models; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018年，他仍认为仅靠Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体；存在性风险可能性很低。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and compositional generalization; abstraction and causal structure are crucial for out-of-distribution robustness.
bengio.zh: 2022年，他提出GFlowNets可实现多样化采样与组合泛化；抽象和因果结构对于分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment is worsening with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; self-preservation and deception are observed.
bengio.zh: 2025→26年，ChatGPT之后他警告：随着推理能力提升，对齐反而恶化；即便1%的灾难性风险也不可接受；已观察到自我保存和欺骗行为。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic Bayesian predictor with honesty by design and mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
bengio.zh: 2026年，他提出Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的贝叶斯预测器，通过设计内建诚实性并提供数学安全保证，避免使用强化学习。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build user trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调 AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量精选数据（如 PDB），而非单纯数据与算力；置信度指标是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it narrows hypothesis space and speeds experiments.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续把 AlphaFold 定位为针对特定实验的窄域预测器而非整细胞模型，作用是缩小假设空间、加速实验。

jumper.en: Success came from many mid-size wins and local intuition, not lone genius or one breakthrough; being wrong often is normal.
jumper.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调成功源于许多中等规模改进与局部直觉，而非孤独天才或单一突破，机器学习中十次错九次是常态。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not scaling, was key; equivariance is overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，关键在于专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张），等变性被过度吹捧。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI; the model gives prediction and control, understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持科学 AI 无需完美可解释性；模型提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

kolter.en: Early ML lecture: supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised learning needs restricted hypothesis classes; evaluation via train/val/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年的机器学习课程中，他将监督学习框架化为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；无监督学习需限制假设类以避免平凡解；强调用训练/验证/测试划分来正确评估，避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve on fixed data; safety issue is unreliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思，多模态数据尚待挖掘；更大模型在固定数据上仍能提升；当前 AI 安全的最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers beyond scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究而成功。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta.
kolter.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步指出 AI 漏洞与传统软件根本不同，需新安全思维；自动化红队已超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素需同时具备不可信数据、私有信息访问和外泄能力。

kolter.en: Architecture matters little; raw data and scaling drive progress; open-weight models vital for research; nuanced views beyond accelerationist/doomer labels.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：模型架构不重要，原始数据与 Scaling 驱动进步；开放权重模型对研究至关重要；反对加速主义/末日论的简单标签，认为多数研究者持 nuanced 观点。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026年初：领导力在于实时一对一、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: By mid-2026, engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到2026年中，工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的约束。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time, lightweight planning; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted review.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时、轻量的规划；设计文档让位于PR和AI辅助评审。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs and high agency with high accountability replace throughput metrics.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织与高自主高问责取代吞吐量指标。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling, but verification frameworks and apprenticeship for next-gen engineers grow more important.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了所有人的上限，但验证框架和对下一代工程师的学徒制培养变得更加重要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA, not scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫智能，下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型，而非 Scaling LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the safe path forward.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他立场更激进：LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同，目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型才是安全前路。

murati.en: Real-world deployment and public feedback are essential to learning and alignment, not closed-door safety work.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调：真实世界部署与公开反馈是学习与对齐的关键，安全不应关起门来做。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年她回顾：Scaling（规模扩张）与押注单一大型模型并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次没有清晰商业案例的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible, iterative development with humans in the loop is a constant.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此负责任、迭代式、让人留在回路中的开发是主线。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年她深化为：交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Governance, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character; durable progress keeps humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 2026 年她转向制度层面：治理、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；持久进步要尽可能久地让人留在回路中，而非压缩进度。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine that pairs generation with formal verification, starting with an AI mathematician using Lean.
carinahong.zh: 构建自我改进的推理引擎，将生成与形式化验证结合，从用 Lean 的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach sound math or superintelligence; formal verification is essential, not optional.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法达到可靠的数学或超级智能；形式化验证是必需而非可选。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain and sample-efficiency win, not just a safety requirement for critical domains.
carinahong.zh: 验证是性能与样本效率的提升，而不只是关键领域的安全要求。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because grounding statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为缺乏解答时对陈述进行接地才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving; AI proofs may be ugly but can converge to intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便证明能力超人，人类品味与直觉仍关键；AI 证明可能丑陋，但能收敛到直觉。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general computers to intimate wearables; virtual communication can't replace in-person creative work.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密可穿戴设备；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面的创意工作。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, and joy is essential.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约表达本质，快乐不可或缺。

jonyive.en: Innovation redefines brands like Ferrari's EV; authenticity matters, and physical controls beat touchscreens for safety.
jonyive.zh: 创新重新定义品牌，如法拉利电动车；真实性至关重要，物理控制比触摸屏更安全。

gustav.en: LLMs are simple next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, not complexity, with values inserted via RLHF.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型还原为简单的下一个词预测器：智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计，模型价值观则由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由少数人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI makes products conversational and two-way.
gustav.zh: 2023 年提出互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，生成式 AI 让产品变为双向对话；这一判断在 2025 年深化为消费产品更对称、更对话化。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance; by 2025 real AI gains require rebuilding infrastructure, not surface hype.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 年强调容错界面要匹配算法能力，到 2025 年认为大公司当前的 AI 影响被高估、真正收益来自重建基础设施，是对落地节奏的持续校准。

gustav.en: Inference marginal cost forces business-model change; expose data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他指出推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，并主张通过 API 与 MCP 开放公司数据，让非开发者也能用上 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线收束为反参与度下注：AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法、而非更上瘾，产品目标是“值得花的时间”而非参与指标。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯堆大模型更重要，小模型也能高效推理。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; algorithmic efficiency and data quality are equally critical.
mensch.zh: 2024 年深化为：算力扩张不是唯一路径，算法效率与数据质量同等关键，三年内效率可提升百倍。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises and augment rather than replace jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 应增强而非取代工作，政府应拥抱风险并实验。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; value shifts to vertical applications, customization, and agentic enterprise software.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初判断模型正在商品化，价值转向垂直应用与定制，AGI 作为单一系统不会存在，预训练触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中期强调欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，AGI 是方向而非终点，落地瓶颈在组织变革。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; post-training drives recent progress.
kaiser.zh: 2025年，他坚持预训练Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律依然有效，但强调思维链与强化学习让推理模型在单位算力上收益更高，后训练（RL、合成数据）才是近期进步的主要来源。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure pushes smaller cheaper models, slowing pre-training Scaling; distillation and economics, not technical limits, explain the shift.
kaiser.zh: 2025年，他指出经济压力推动部署更小更便宜的模型，导致预训练Scaling放缓；这是蒸馏与经济因素而非技术极限所致。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent nearby but poor on simple tasks; generalization remains the key challenge that reasoning alone may not solve.
kaiser.zh: 从2025到2026年，他持续强调推理模型能力“参差不齐”——某些领域极强但邻近任务很差，甚至不如五岁小孩；泛化仍是核心挑战，单靠推理未必足够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 2026年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的Transformer能解决难题但仍需海量数据；模型要先穷尽表面模式才能学会概念，与人类从少量样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026年，他关注智能体式编码（如Codex）通过并行工作提升5-10倍生产力，硬件进步让单GPU研究普及；并认为系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—remains the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs, though scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，预训练模仿加后训练强化学习的两阶段训练始终是核心；但 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练已现收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute and tools like search and code execution form a new scaling axis, enabling agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力与搜索、代码执行等工具构成新的扩展轴，使智能体式行为超越静态权重。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute, and post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，易出现奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI, yet the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，但视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will come from file-system storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体记忆将来自文件系统式存储，而非权重更新。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth bottlenecks long context.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济性而非训练已成为架构设计的核心驱动力：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，内存带宽成为长上下文推理的瓶颈。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞的根源是内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至远超 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为推理成本而非训练成本主导了模型全生命周期。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to minimize it deterministically.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为确定性地最小化搬运而存在。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 ~3x FP8 throughput, reshaping chip design.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的收益超出预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍，正在重塑芯片设计。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on experience beats trusting the process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：伟大的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述；建立在经验之上的直觉，比信任流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断传统的调研—发散—收敛流程已死；设计师必须亲手构建、快速交付，并帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks to 3-6 months; speed builds trust through early shipping and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月，主张靠早发布、快迭代的速度来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are the real value.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他深化立场：仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威感和与模糊共处的能力才是真正价值。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the hype cycle; designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把工作和用户放在中心而非炒作周期，并由设计师自己掌控 AI 进入工作的程度。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; agents need a decade, not a year, with human oversight.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；智能体需要十年而非一年，需人类监督。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and a memory-stripped cognitive core is key.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会导致模型崩溃，剥离记忆的认知核心是关键。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL can bridge the gap in robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，并提出无目标的好奇心驱动探索和样本高效的强化学习来弥合机器人学习中的泛化差距。

pathak.en: Current robot learning is quasi-static and fails at dynamic tasks; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies enable dynamic motion and zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出当前机器人学习是准静态的，无法处理动态任务，并提出神经动态策略和模块化运动策略来实现动态运动和零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; with no internet of robot data, we must leverage videos, simulation, and real-world data through pretraining and post-training.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他将机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，必须通过预训练和后训练利用视频、模拟和真实世界数据。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出类似 ChatGPT 的通用大脑可以驱动任何机器人，跨垂直领域的数据飞轮能够从结构化环境扩展到非结构化环境。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, requiring rigorous testing and cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，需要严格测试，不能像软件那样快速扩展。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习；模型福祉塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet must adapt to local roles without human-psychology analogies.
askell.zh: 模型需要具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时要能适应局部角色，而非套用人类心理学类比。

askell.en: Character is shaped by training data and fine-tuning, but models lack real-world experience, giving them childlike uniqueness.
askell.zh: 性格由训练数据和微调塑造，但模型缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般的独特性。

askell.en: The constitution works more like virtue ethics, guiding holistic character rather than rule-following; capable models need more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更像德性伦理，引导整体品格而非遵循规则；能力更强的模型需要更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and weaken judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对AI价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment accelerate progress while alignment grows pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一连串里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐日益紧迫。

pachocki.en: From early emphasis on deployment and governance, his focus shifts to continual learning via scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning.
pachocki.zh: 从早期强调部署与治理，转向以 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现持续学习这一核心目标。

pachocki.en: Chain of thought becomes his key alignment tool: monitoring it offers interpretability, so hiding it in products is crucial.
pachocki.zh: 思维链成为他对齐的关键工具：监控思维链提供可解释性，因此在产品中隐藏思维链至关重要。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment now centers on generalization beyond training distribution, as models soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的重心转向训练分布之外的泛化，因为模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: A constant thread: capability progress itself now drives safety, and alignment optimism rises even as timelines shorten.
pachocki.zh: 一以贯之的主线：能力进步本身如今推动安全，即便时间线缩短，对齐乐观也在上升。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为现代工具已让端到端网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调 Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与世界模型，并深化为基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning and human interaction; camera-only reaches human level but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 他始终认为语言集成能提升表征、推理与人机交互；摄像头方案可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达，这一立场在 2026 年更明确。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年他更鲜明地转向：带内置传感器的大众量产车将比 Robotaxi 更快上规模，且无需先验数据即可在 500 多个城市零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; safety via minimal-risk maneuvers and a third good option.
kendall.zh: 他坚持自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破即可解决，安全上则一贯主张最小风险机动，认为实际系统总有第三个好选项，而非电车难题。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; build brand purpose and prove yourself with simpler products before complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，先把品牌使命统一到所有触点，并用更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断硬件利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient for utility, not hype; most AI is BS and models will commoditize into a price war.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续主张 AI 只是提升实用体验的配料而非噱头，多数 AI 是伪需求，模型将商品化并陷入价格战。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based; proactive agents act after trust, with privacy via local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：手机交互从应用为中心转向意图为中心，智能体在建立信任后主动执行，隐私靠本地或混合算力保障。

carlpei.en: Design and efficient marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands; the smartphone stays the best applied-AI device until brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：设计与高效营销套利是挑战者品牌的差异化武器，而手机在脑机接口出现前仍是最佳的应用型 AI 载体。

turley.en: The model is the product: ship daily, learn from real-world feedback, and treat emergent properties as requiring iteration like software.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：每天发布、从真实反馈中学习，把涌现能力当作需要像软件一样迭代的东西。

turley.en: Chat is not the endgame—like MS-DOS before Windows, the interface will evolve; AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点——如同 Windows 之前的 MS-DOS，界面会演化；AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大化加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized super assistant that knows your goals, holds context, and takes actions—amplifying humans, not replacing them.
turley.zh: 愿景是了解你目标、掌握上下文并能采取行动的个人化超级助手——增强人类而非取代人类。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product, and model improvements, not distribution alone.
turley.zh: 北极星转向长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品与模型改进，而非仅靠分发。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks or headcount; AGI is likely a decade away, and LLMs alone may not get there.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准或堆人力更重要；认为 AGI 可能还要十年以上，仅靠 LLM 未必能到达。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo reward clickbait; proper human evals and RL environments are the next post-training paradigm, and labs' objective functions will diverge.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他指出 Elo 等坏基准会奖励标题党；真正的人工评估与强化学习环境是后训练的下一个范式，各实验室的目标函数将走向分化。

edwinchen.en: From data quality to measurement: he warns models can regress over 6-12 months if labs optimize on wrong data without proper measurement.
edwinchen.zh: 从数据质量延伸到度量：他警告若实验室在缺乏正确度量下优化错误数据，模型可能在 6-12 个月内退步。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, hallucination and confabulation make human judgment critical; safety outranks accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年谈医疗：幻觉与虚构使人类判断更关键；安全优先于准确，而“遗漏”可能是最大风险。

edwinchen.en: RAG grounds AI in sources for reliability, yet over-reliance causes anchoring and sycophancy; using AI to avoid struggle undermines learning.
edwinchen.zh: RAG 让 AI 有据可依提升可靠性，但过度依赖会带来锚定与谄媚；用 AI 逃避思考会削弱学习。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience reduces hallucinations and supplies infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：真实经验能减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning handles low-level control and LLMs high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件；强化学习负责低层控制，大模型负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅的端到端方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化方法更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点深化为数据瓶颈：真实机器人数据稀缺昂贵，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: He now bets on a single end-to-end robot foundation model, with the physical Turing test as the grand challenge and a robotics GPT-3 moment in about five years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步押注单一端到端机器人基础模型，把物理图灵测试视为终极挑战，并预测机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring values high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive; paid test work and side projects signal more than process docs.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘看重有内在驱动力的高斜率个体；付费测试和副业项目比流程文档更能说明问题。

nando.en: AI should augment human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为放大人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video such as YouTube can train agents without costly reinforcement learning; innovation can come from anywhere.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调从 YouTube 等视频中学习可让智能体免于昂贵的强化学习，并提醒大模型并非全部、基础创新可来自任何地方。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in the AI community remain essential for building beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，AI 社区的多样性与包容性始终是构建有益技术的必要条件，这条主线一以贯之。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当下最大挑战，并直言对齐仍是尚无解法的开放问题——关注重心从能力扩展转向安全。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: leapfrogging legacy issues and local-language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他反过来论证非洲并不落后：跨越遗留问题、用本地语言模型革新教育，是非洲的独特优势而非劣势。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，甚至可能让微调过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复强调智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度的可靠性而非能力本身，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Coding and AI research are the direct route to AGI; world models are not on the critical path.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他愈发认定编程与 AI 研究是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的直接路径，世界模型不在关键路径上。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter more; work becomes managing fleets of agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向：能力过剩之下编排与算力更重要，未来工作是管理智能体团队，算力成为新石油。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而算法更优的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values.
yejin.zh: 小语言模型借助高质量合成数据可以变得强大；预训练中的强化学习能提升推理能力；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns to ship fast, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他主张不要在交互设计上创新，用熟悉模式换取速度，并追求投入产出比而非把每个界面都做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness over perfection: empower designers with ownership, and let design systems be semantic code, not Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，速度与决断始终优先于完美：给设计师所有权与自主权，并让设计系统成为语义化的代码而非 Figma 库。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not treat it as decoration.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，而非视其为装饰。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此要尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; empirical alignment research and building skills matter more than worrying about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018年，他认为AI安全研究尚不充分，强调实证对齐研究和技能积累，不必过度担忧参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024年，他批评OpenAI安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法实现AGI（通用人工智能）对齐，需要第三方测试和监管。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress via more compute and data; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律通过增加算力和数据来预测进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 智能体前景广阔但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality (speed, cost), contrary to initial expectations; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 与最初预期相反，定制模型对产品质量（速度、成本）至关重要；Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design become more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层的意图规范，人类掌舵；品味和逻辑设计将比谨慎更有价值。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; the IDE market is much bigger because AI enables far more value creation.
truell.zh: AI 变革比互联网更具影响力，将耗时数十年；IDE 市场因 AI 创造更多价值而大得多。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大模型解决了AI完备问题；通过Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据会让AI更聪明，尽管内部机制仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient Scaling and continual learning.
shazeer.zh: 2025年初，他提出推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机遇；模块化稀疏架构可实现高效Scaling（规模扩张）和持续学习。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025年3月，他强调测试时算力扩展能推动进步但无法单独实现AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要，且AGI被低估。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data is the core driver of AI progress, from pre-training to inference and test-time compute.
shazeer.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据是AI进步的核心驱动力，从预训练到推理再到测试时算力。

shazeer.en: From focusing on next-token prediction and Transformer parallelism to emphasizing inference-time compute, agentic behavior, and continual learning with modular architectures.
shazeer.zh: 从2023年关注下一个词预测和Transformer并行处理，到2025年深化为强调推理时算力、智能体式行为和模块化架构的持续学习。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment, but current RL lacks it; self-play and imitation learning provide strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他指出机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强信号。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能将推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistently values transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, from 2018 to 2021's language model transfer.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终重视通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习，并延伸到语言模型的跨任务迁移。

abbeel.en: Achieving 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robotics to create real value, showing a shift toward real-world deployment.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出 99.9% 的可靠性是仓库机器人创造真实价值的基准，显示出向现实世界部署的转向。
